transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, um, what brings me in is that I’ve been waking up lately with this... this heavy, hollow sadness. I work as a choreographer, and the best way I can really describe it is that it feels like the studio lights are on, but there’s just no music in me anymore. It's just a very heavy, sad feeling that I can't seem to shake.
Have you lost interest in activities or things you used to enjoy, like choreography or anything else?

Yeah, I have. Choreography used to be everything to me. I'd spend hours just working out routines, and now... I don't know, I just don't care about it. I don't really want to do it, or anything else, honestly. I just kind of sit there.
Do you feel like you don’t enjoy anything anymore, even things that used to make you happy?

Yeah, exactly. Like I was just saying... I really don't get any joy out of anything right now. Even the things that used to make me really happy, like dancing, just feel completely empty. I just don't have the desire for any of it anymore.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the time, almost every day?
Yeah, pretty much every day. Like I mentioned when I first came in, I wake up with that heavy, hollow sadness most mornings. It's just a constant feeling lately.
Have you been feeling fatigued or like you have no energy lately?

Yeah, I have. I just feel... wiped out all the time. Even small things take it all out of me. Like, if I just answer one email to a dancer or take a shower with this ankle brace on, I'm completely exhausted. And lying down doesn't even really help. I don't feel recharged at all.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or feeling guilty about things you’ve done or didn’t do?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep replaying the cancelled performances in my head. I keep telling myself that I let the dancers down, the funders, the whole community. It's just this heavy guilt all the time, even though people have been a lot kinder about it than I deserve.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, or have you been sleeping too much lately?

My sleep has been kind of all over the place. Um, before this, there were nights I'd just stay up sketching formations until dawn, not really needing sleep. But lately... lately I fall asleep completely exhausted, but then I wake up around four or five in the morning, and my stomach is just tight, and I can't get back to sleep.
Have you been having any thoughts about ending your life or that you'd be better off dead?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, I feel really guilty and overwhelmed right now, but... no, I don't want to end my life or anything. I just want to figure out how to get past this.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um, I think this part... the feeling so down and guilty, it's been going on for about nine months now.
Have you ever felt this way before, with the same kind of sadness and loss of interest, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?

Um, no, I don't think I've ever felt quite like this before. I mean, I've been stressed or upset about work in the past—like if a performance wasn't coming together—but... not this kind of heavy, constant sadness. I'm pretty sure this is the first time I've experienced anything like this.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually high, extremely energized, or so confident that you didn’t sleep much but still felt fine?

Yeah, um... actually, before all this started, there was a time like that. I just felt... dazzlingly alive, I guess. Like I had all this energy and I didn't need to sleep much at all. I was coming up with all these ideas for a new piece. But then... I don't know, I would also get really furious, really suddenly. Like, if anyone questioned my plan, or if someone reminded me that my ankle was still recovering and I needed to rest it... I would just snap at them. It was a really intense time.
How long did that previous period of high energy and feeling unusually confident last?

Um... I'm not really sure, to be honest. It's kind of hard to pinpoint exactly when it started and stopped. I just know it was going on right before I crashed and started feeling so heavy and down. But as for an exact number of days or weeks... I honestly couldn't tell you.
Can you estimate how long that period of high energy and confidence lasted before it ended?

I... I really can't. Like I just said, I don't have a clear timeline in my head. It all kind of blurs together. I just remember how intense it felt, and then hitting a wall and feeling like this. But if you need an actual number of days or weeks, I... I honestly just don't know.
